title: beta-nebula-item-rights-evidence-v613
implementation: Added immutable V613 per-image rights evidence records with source identity, policy page, rights page, local evidence path and digest, reviewer, review time, credit confirmation, decision, and status.

Added fail-closed assessment and transition APIs: incomplete evidence stays pending, rejected decisions stay rejected, and cleared decisions require complete item-level evidence while candidate-only/runtime gates remain closed.

Added receipt reference preservation from the three sealed nebula manifests into the projection, V612 review pack, and V613 rights pack; references are explicitly descriptive and are not treated as a rights grant.
Added deterministic V613 pack generation, nested equality checks, schema/decision tamper tests, source identity checks, queue fingerprints, and serialization validation.

Updated the review panel to expose V613 pending rights evidence, NASA policy URL, reviewer/decision fields, receipt-pack boundary, and the fact that no review action opens visual or scientific runtime admission.

codeChange.method: Count nonblank, noncomment lines in the four new R53 utility/pack files. Integration edits to the existing review panel and projection pack are additional and are not needed to reach the threshold.

mobile.reason: R52 browser viewport control remained unable to change the in-app viewport; no mobile pass is claimed

browser.scope: HTTP, browser and visual interaction evidence only; not GPU/FPS, public deployment, real-user, or scientific validation
